captions.detailed: A compact monocular laboratory microscope featuring a sturdy cast metal base and a tapered vertical support arm in light gray. It includes a dark gray specimen stage, a rotating objective nosepiece with multiple lenses, and an angled monocular eyepiece tube on top. A black focusing knob is mounted on the side of the arm.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated compact monocular laboratory microscope with a light gray cast base and tapered arm, a black circular specimen stage, a rotating objective nosepiece turret, and a side-mounted focus knob.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope by modeling the cast base and tapered vertical arm using extruded profiles and boolean operations. Define the specimen stage as a flat cylindrical platform, the rotating nosepiece with small objective cylinders, and the monocular tube as an angled cylinder. Set up a revolute joint for the nosepiece turret, a prismatic joint for the stage focusing slide, and a revolute joint for the side focus knob.
